entities.summary: Egara Tenjin Shrine , is a Shinto shrine in Kamakura. Having been founded according to legend by an unknown priest in 1104, it is one of the few extant religious institutions in the area to predate the advent of Minamoto no Yoritomo, who arrived here in 1181. Like all other Tenjin shrines in Japan, it enshrines the spirit of famous scholar and politician Sugawara no Michizane under the name Tenjin. For this reason, the kami is believed to be a protector of intellectual pursuits. Egara Tenjinsha Shrine is a Shinto shrine in Asia, established in 1104. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
